title: Weather forecast for the Flood: 49 days of rain, 100% precipitation
summary: A mock weather-app forecast for Earth on a Sunday in 2000 B.C. showing 100% precipitation, 100% humidity and 100+ mph wind, a 49-day extended forecast of rain every day except the first and last two days, and an hourly bar of 100%.

pictures.description: Mock weather-app screen in grey tones: a large sun-and-cloud icon beside the Earth forecast text, a yellow hourly bar chart where every time slot reads 100%, and a 7-column by 7-row grid of weather icons. The first row (Sunday to Saturday) shows sun with cloud, then rain clouds fill the grid until the last two cells (Friday and Saturday of the final row) return to sun with cloud.
